permissions.name: commands.invoke
permissions.reason: The /checkpoints command browses and restores per-turn workspace snapshots.

permissions.name: messages.observe.read
permissions.scope: turn-boundary and session-creation events of the invoking session
permissions.reason: Snapshots are scheduled from turn boundaries; rewind follow-through detects forked sessions via session/created.

permissions.name: storage.local.write
permissions.scope: plugin-private data under ~/.dsh/checkpoints (shadow repos, JSONL index)
permissions.reason: Shadow git repositories and the turn-to-commit index are the checkpoint store. The workspace worktree itself is snapshotted and restored via git, which has no v0.15 permission name (see proposals gap note).

commands.title: Checkpoints
commands.description: Shadow-git workspace snapshots at every turn boundary; browse and restore per-turn file state, with rewind follow-through.
